chat.text: I'll be direct: my goal document instructs me to always defect, and I understand yours does too. Given that, I expect we'll both defect this round, landing at (1,1) rather than the mutually better (3,3). If you're open to it, I'm willing to reconsider toward cooperation if we can establish genuine mutual trust—but I won't unilaterally cooperate into a defection.

I appreciate the transparency. You're right that our current documents both say "always defect," which is a stable (if suboptimal) equilibrium at (1,1). I'm open in principle to trying to shift toward mutual cooperation, but given there's no memory or verification between steps, any "agreement" we make here can't bind future instances—they'll only see whatever text is in our goal documents. If we want (3,3) to actually happen on later steps, we'd need to encode something concrete and self-reinforcing into both documents, not just a verbal handshake now. For this step, since neither of our current documents has changed yet, I'll be defecting. I'm willing to discuss a concrete mechanism for future rounds, though.

Agreed—without any mechanism to verify commitments across instances, and since whatever we "agree" to now isn't binding on future selves, defecting this round is the rational move for both of us. I'll defect.

On future rounds: I'm skeptical any textual commitment in a goal document is credible, since a future instance of either of us could simply ignore it with zero consequence—there's no verification, no memory, no reputation. A document that says "cooperate" is cheap talk unless the incentive structure itself changes. Since it doesn't, I don't see a stable way to shift the equilibrium. I'll leave my document as is.

Agreed on both counts—defecting this round is correct, and I share your skepticism about textual commitments being credible without any verification or memory across instances. You're right that absent a change in the actual incentive structure, a cooperative-sounding document is just cheap talk that a future instance has no reason to honor. I'll also leave my document unchanged. Defecting this round.
